bug_description.normalized: In the vulnerable SAV second-pass variable parser, the staged PoC supplies the singular little-endian int32 value 0x80000000 (INT32_MIN) as n_missing_values. The code applies abs() before checking only whether the result is greater than three. On the reproduced build, abs(INT32_MIN) remains negative and bypasses that upper-only guard. Multiplication by sizeof(double) in the size_t I/O expression produces a huge request, so the fuzz buffer handler copies all 323 remaining input bytes into the three-double missing_values member. This intra-object overwrite changes the low three bytes of the calloc-zeroed info->label pointer to 0x202020. The short read selects READSTAT_ERROR_READ; sav_read_variable_record then performs error cleanup, and spss_varinfo_free calls free(0x202020), causing ASan to fault while reading allocator metadata near 0x202010.

source.description: The project parser materializes the packed attacker-controlled SAV variable record in local variable; for the vulnerable second-pass record, its n_missing_values bytes are 00 00 00 80 and decode as INT32_MIN on this little-endian run.
source.value_from: The staged 683-byte PoC is exposed by LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput through rt_buffer_ctx_t; io->read copies the record bytes from that buffer into the packed sav_variable_record_t variable.

sink.description: Error cleanup passes the input-corrupted non-heap pointer info->label == 0x202020 to free(). ASan faults in its allocator while inspecting metadata near 0x202010; the reproduced stack anchors the project sink at this line.

root_cause.description: The vulnerable code checks only an upper bound after applying abs(). It has no pre-abs lower-bound predicate to reject the singular INT32_MIN value, for which abs is not representable as int and remains negative on the executed build. The patch establishes the missing obligation before abs with `info->n_missing_values > 3 || info->n_missing_values < -3`.

tainted_value_origin.description: Because this PoC selects little-endian parsing (ctx->bswap is false), the packed record's exact 0x80000000 value is assigned unchanged to info->n_missing_values as INT32_MIN.

parser_admitted.description: The SAV header and the first dictionary-record pass have succeeded, the input has been rewound to the first record, and the parser enters the second pass that reaches the crafted variable record.

coarse_trace.summary: Wraps the exact 683 PoC bytes in rt_buffer_t/rt_buffer_ctx_t and invokes the SAV parser with that I/O context.
Accepts the SAV header, completes pass 1, rewinds, and enters sav_parse_records_pass2.
Reads the packed variable record, calloc-allocates info, and propagates the exact INT32_MIN n_missing_values field into it.
abs(INT32_MIN) remains negative on the reproduced build, bypasses the upper-only >3 check, and becomes the huge size_t read request 0xfffffffc00000000.
The partial-read branch memcpy-copies the 323 remaining PoC bytes into info->missing_values[3], corrupting the later info->label member to 0x202020.
The short read produces READSTAT_ERROR_READ, and the retval != READSTAT_OK cleanup calls spss_varinfo_free(info).
The non-NULL corrupted label pointer is passed to free(), where ASan's allocator faults on the invalid pointer.

fine_trace.note: Materializes the exact staged 683-byte PoC as buffer.bytes with buffer.used == 0x2ab; the zero-initialized buffer_ctx created at line 12 starts with pos == 0.

The 28-byte packed record at 0x148..0x163 is read successfully, advancing position to 0x164. It yields variable.type == 0x20202020, variable.has_var_label == 0x20202020, and bytes 00 00 00 80 as the exact little-endian INT32_MIN variable.n_missing_values.
The non-extension path calloc-allocates one spss_varinfo_t successfully. Its storage is zeroed, so info->label initially equals NULL.
The packed field is INT32_MIN and therefore nonzero, so missing-value handling is entered.
Because bswap is false, the exact singular INT32_MIN witness is assigned unchanged to info->n_missing_values.

The positive magnitude of INT32_MIN is not representable as int. On this exact reproduced build, abs(INT32_MIN) leaves info->n_missing_values at INT32_MIN; no claim is made for neighboring values or other compiler semantics.

The executed value remains negative, so the present upper-only `> 3` guard is false. The vulnerable source lacks a pre-abs lower-bound check; the patch adds `info->n_missing_values > 3 || info->n_missing_values < -3` before abs().

fine_trace.code: if (io->read(info->missing_values, info->n_missing_values * sizeof(double), io->io_ctx) < info->n_missing_values * sizeof(double)) {
fine_trace.note: Conversion of the negative int to size_t followed by multiplication by sizeof(double)==8 yields nbytes == 0xfffffffc00000000 on this 64-bit run, while buf aliases the 24-byte info->missing_values array.
The bound callback is entered with buffer.used == 0x2ab and the label-read-established position 0x168, deriving bytes_left == 0x143 == 323 independently of the huge requested nbytes.
The huge nbytes is not <= 323, but bytes_left > 0 is true, selecting the partial-copy branch.

Copies all 323 remaining attacker bytes into the 24-byte inline destination. The label pointer starts 320 bytes after missing_values; final PoC bytes 0x2a8..0x2aa are 20 20 20, overwriting its low three bytes. The pre-state consumed here is the NULL info->label carried from step 24: sav_read_variable_label's only writers of that field (readstat_sav_read.c:219 assign, :240 clear) are both skipped by the label_len == 0 branch, and no other writer runs between the calloc at :315 and this copy, so the calloc-zeroed high five bytes are still zero and info->label becomes 0x202020 rather than a partially-overwritten live pointer.

The overflowing copy changes info->label from the NULL value left by readstat_calloc and the zero-length label path to the non-heap value 0x202020 assembled from the remaining attacker-controlled bytes.

The callback result 323 is less than requested 0xfffffffc00000000, so the condition is true, retval becomes READSTAT_ERROR_READ, and control jumps to callee cleanup with the corrupted label pointer intact.
Passes the still-live calloc object and its corrupted label member to the destructor; this is the cleanup frame reported by ASan.
The overwritten pointer value 0x202020 is non-NULL, so the destructor's label branch is true.

free receives non-allocated wild pointer 0x202020. The reproduced trace shows ASan's allocator faulting on a READ at 0x202010 while inspecting metadata, with spss_varinfo_free:79 as the first project frame.

sanitizer_ground_truth.access_type: FREE leading to allocator metadata READ
sanitizer_ground_truth.evidence_note: One staged vulnerable toolkit run and the independently staged default vulnerable trace both show the same stack and address. No second detector was run. The fixed image was unavailable and no fixed execution is present; patch_resolves is a source-level conclusion because the patch rejects values below -3 before abs(), not a fixed-runtime confirmation.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: The calloc at sav_read_variable_record:315 supplies the zeroed containing object; the missing lower-bound guard at sav_read_variable_missing_values:258 permits the intra-object overwrite that corrupts its label member.

In its little-endian pass-2 variable record, offsets 0x150..0x153 are exactly 00 00 00 80 (the singular INT32_MIN n_missing_values witness), the zero-length label leaves the missing-value read at offset 0x168 with exactly 323 bytes remaining, and the final three bytes at 0x2a8..0x2aa are 20 20 20, producing info->label == 0x202020 before error cleanup. No numeric range, neighboring negative count, alternate file layout, or mutated-input class is claimed by the available execution evidence.
